example_en: It saddens me to think that we'll never see her again.
example_zh: 一想到我們再也見不到她了就令我非常傷心。

chinese_meaning: 心智健全的，神智正常的;頭腦清醒的
example_en: In the doctor's opinion he was sane at the time of the murder.
example_zh: 按照醫生的看法，他在謀殺時是神志清醒的。

example_en: She anxiously scanned the faces of the men leaving the train.
example_zh: 她急切地盯著一張張走下火車的人的臉。

example_en: I was scarcely able to move my arm after the accident.
example_zh: 那場事故以後，我的手臂幾乎不能動了。

example_en: the scarcity of skilled workers
example_zh: 缺乏熟練工人

chinese_meaning: 分散的;散佈的;疏疏落落的
example_en: Toys and books were scattered about/around the room.
example_zh: 房間裡到處都是玩具和書籍。

chinese_meaning: 可能發生的事態;設想; 場景
example_en: There are several possible scenarios.
example_zh: 有幾種可能出現的局面。

example_en: She scrambled up the steep hillside and over the rocks.
example_zh: 她爬上了陡峭的山坡，翻過岩石。

example_en: They're considering scrapping the tax and raising the money in other ways.
example_zh: 他們正在考慮廢除這個稅目，用其他方法募集款項。

example_en: The government's record will be subjected to/come under (close) scrutiny in the weeks before the election.
example_zh: 政府的作爲將在選前幾個星期接受審查。

example_en: He felt that she was trying to seduce him.
example_zh: 他覺得她在勾引他。

example_en: a sensational sports car/dress
example_zh: 極好的跑車／連衣裙

example_en: Nationalist sentiment has increased in the area since the bombing.
example_zh: 爆炸案發生以來，該地區的民族主義情緒開始高漲。

chinese_meaning: 多愁善感的；感情用事的
example_en: Why be sentimental about that old coat? There's no point in keeping it just because you were wearing it when you first met me.
example_zh: 爲甚麽對那件舊外套依依不捨？僅僅因爲你第一次遇到我時穿著這件衣服就留著它，這毫無意義。

chinese_meaning: 一連串；一系列；順序，次序
example_en: The first chapter describes the strange sequence of events that led to his death.
example_zh: 第一章描述了造成他死亡的一連串奇特事件。

example_en: She has a lovely serene face.
example_zh: 她長著一張可愛而安詳的臉。

example_en: I admired her serenity in the midst of so much chaos.
example_zh: 我欽佩她在混亂中還能保持平靜。

example_en: My pencil is blunt - I'll have to sharpen it.
example_zh: 我的鉛筆鈍了——我得削一下。

example_en: He was shrewd enough not to take the job when there was the possibility of getting a better one a few months later.
example_zh: 沒有接受那份工作算他聰明，因爲幾個月後他有可能會得到更好的。

chinese_meaning: （表示不知道或不感興趣）聳（肩）
example_en: "Where's Dad?" "How should I know?" replied my brother, shrugging.
example_zh: 「爸爸在哪裡？」「我怎麽知道？」哥哥聳了聳肩，答道。

chinese_meaning: （因有令人不快的想法或感覺而）戰慄，發抖
example_en: The sight of so much blood made him shudder.
example_zh: 看到那麽多的血，他不禁渾身顫抖。

example_en: I have four siblings: three brothers and a sister.
example_zh: 我有四個兄弟姐妹：三個兄弟，一個姐姐。

example_en: The fence is leaning sideways.
example_zh: 柵欄向一邊傾斜。

chinese_meaning: （違反宗教戒律或道德規範的）罪，罪過
example_en: to commit/confess a sin
example_zh: 犯罪／懺悔罪過

example_en: The priest was a man of deep sincerity.
example_zh: 那位牧師是個十分真誠的人。

example_en: Many experts remain skeptical about/of his claims.
example_zh: 很多專家對他的主張仍然持懷疑態度。

example_en: The soldiers discovered a pile of human skulls and bones.
example_zh: 士兵們發現了一堆人的頭蓋骨和白骨。

example_en: She gave her son a slap for behaving badly.
example_zh: 她因兒子不聽話給了他一巴掌。

example_en: Hardly anyone in the town escaped the slaughter when the rebels were defeated.
example_zh: 叛亂分子被擊敗後，鎮上幾乎沒有人能逃過隨之而來的大屠殺。

example_en: He put his hands around her slender waist.
example_zh: 他雙手摟住了她纖細的腰。

example_en: a smoky pub/restaurant
example_zh: 煙霧彌漫的酒吧／餐館

example_en: She was caught trying to smuggle 26 kilos of heroin out of/into the country.
example_zh: 她在企圖把兩萬六千克的海洛因走私出境／入境時被抓獲。

chinese_meaning: 突然折斷，哢嚓一聲折斷
example_en: You'll snap that ruler if you bend it too far.
example_zh: 如果你把那把尺子彎得太厲害，它就會哢嚓一下折斷。

example_en: He snatched the photos out of my hand before I had a chance to look at them.
example_zh: 我還沒來得及看，他就一把搶走了我手裡的照片。

chinese_meaning: 偷偷地走，潛行；偷帶，偷拿
example_en: I managed to sneak in through the back door while she wasn't looking.
example_zh: 我趁她不注意從後門偷偷溜了進來。

example_en: He sniffed his socks to see if they needed washing.
example_zh: 他嗅了嗅自己的襪子，看是否需要洗了。

example_en: All night long fireworks soared into the sky.
example_zh: 整個晚上煙火不斷地竄上高空。

example_en: Are you sober enough to drive, Jim?
example_zh: 吉姆，你夠不夠清醒，可以開車嗎？

example_en: On the hill, a solitary figure was busy chopping down trees.
example_zh: 山上，有個人正忙著砍樹。

chinese_meaning: 悲痛，傷心，悔恨;傷心事，不幸
example_en: The sorrow she felt over/at the death of her husband was almost too much to bear.
example_zh: 她對丈夫的去世悲痛萬分，幾乎難以承受。

example_en: a garden spade
example_zh: 園藝鏟

example_en: Sparks were flying out of the bonfire and blowing everywhere.
example_zh: 營火中飛濺出很多火星，迸得到處都是。

example_en: He has a collection of rare insect specimens.
example_zh: 他收集了很多稀有昆蟲的標本。

example_en: The colours of the spectrum - red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and violet - can be seen in a rainbow.
example_zh: 光譜中的紅、橙、黃、綠、藍、靛、紫諸色都可以在彩虹中見到。

example_en: I don't know why she did it - I'm just speculating.
example_zh: 我不知道她爲甚麽那麽做——我只是猜測。

example_en: Bob Ewell spat contemptuously right in the lawyer's face.
example_zh: 鮑勃‧尤厄爾輕蔑地朝律師臉上吐了口唾沫。

example_en: They bought a decaying 16th-century manor house and restored it to its original splendour.
example_zh: 他們買了一幢破敗的16世紀莊園宅邸，經過整修使它恢復了先前的富麗堂皇。

example_en: In 60 percent of the households surveyed both spouses went out to work.
example_zh: 在60%的受調查的家庭中，夫妻雙方都外出工作。

example_en: Sprinkle a few herbs on the pizza./Sprinkle the pizza with a few herbs.
example_zh: 在披薩上撒些香料調味。

example_en: Rising consumer sales have the effect of spurring the economy to faster growth.
example_zh: 消費的成長有刺激經濟加速發展的作用。

example_en: An army bomb squad arrived and defused the bomb.
example_zh: 一個陸軍防爆小組趕到，拆除了炸彈。

chinese_meaning: 搖晃;蹣跚;踉踉蹌蹌地走
example_en: After he was attacked, he managed to stagger to the phone and call for help.
example_zh: 他遇襲後，跌跌撞撞地走到電話旁打電話求救。

example_en: Tomato sauce stains terribly - it's really difficult to get it out of clothes.
example_zh: 蕃茄醬一沾上就很麻煩——很難把它從衣服上洗掉。

example_en: The doctor's stance on the issue of abortion is well known.
example_zh: 這位醫生在墮胎問題上的立場眾人皆知。

example_en: "I have to put aside my emotions," he says, "and consider it from a professional standpoint."
example_zh: 「我必須除去個人感情，」他說：「以專業的眼光去看它。」

example_en: 20 million people face starvation unless a vast emergency aid programme is launched.
example_zh: 若不啟動大型緊急援助專案計劃，兩千萬人將有餓死的危險。

example_en: a stern look/warning/voice
example_zh: 嚴厲的目光／警告／語氣

chinese_meaning: 刺激（物），激勵（物）；促進因素
example_en: Foreign investment has been a stimulus to the industry.
example_zh: 外國投資促進該產業的發展。

example_en: Secure the two pieces together with a couple of stitches.
example_zh: 縫上幾針，把兩塊布縫在一起。

example_en: Could you help me fasten this strap around my suitcase?
example_zh: 你能幫我用這條帶子把手提箱繫緊嗎？

chinese_meaning: （尤指長期或不畏艱難地）努力，奮鬥，力爭
example_en: Mr Roe has kindled expectations that he must now strive to live up to.
example_zh: 羅先生激發了人們的期望，現在他必須努力不辜負這種期望。

example_en: The political reforms have led to major structural changes in the economy.
example_zh: 政治改革導致經濟結構的重大變化。

example_en: Running along the beach, she stumbled on a log and fell on the sand.
example_zh: 她沿著海灘跑步時絆到一塊木頭上摔倒了。

chinese_meaning: 隱約的;暗淡的;不易察覺的，不明顯的;微妙的
example_en: The room was painted a subtle shade of pink.
example_zh: 房間被刷成了淡粉色。

example_en: It was the team's fourth successive defeat.
example_zh: 那是球隊接連第四次失利。

example_en: She was sitting on the grass sucking lemonade through a straw.
example_zh: 她坐在草地上，用吸管吸著檸檬汁。

chinese_meaning: 控告，對…提起訴訟（尤指要求賠償）
example_en: He was so furious about the accusations in the letter that he threatened to sue.
example_zh: 他對信裡的指控憤怒至極，揚言要控告對方。

chinese_meaning: 高峰會，領袖會議，最高級會議
example_en: a summit meeting
example_zh: 高峰會議

chinese_meaning: 命令…到（某地）;傳喚;召喚;召集
example_en: General Rattigan summoned reinforcements to help resist the attack.
example_zh: 拉蒂根將軍命令增援部隊協助抵擋進攻。

example_en: He's fun to be with, but he's very superficial.
example_zh: 和他在一起很有趣，但是他見識很膚淺。

example_en: The Australian team soon demonstrated their superiority over the opposition.
example_zh: 澳大利亞隊很快在對手面前顯示出優勢。

example_en: The doctor said she should be taking vitamin supplements.
example_zh: 醫生說她應該服用維生素補充劑。

example_en: The Hungarian uprising in 1956 was suppressed by the Soviet Union.
example_zh: 1956年匈牙利起義受到蘇聯武力鎮壓。

example_en: His time for the 100 metres surpassed the previous world record by one hundredth of a second.
example_zh: 他以0.01秒的優勢打破了100米短跑的前世界紀錄。

example_en: The world is now producing large food surpluses.
example_zh: 世界上目前生產的食品大大過剩。

example_en: They would rather die than surrender (to the invaders).
example_zh: 他們寧死也不（向侵略者）投降。

example_en: She kept him in suspense for several days before she said that she would marry him.
example_zh: 她讓他焦慮地等了好幾天，才告訴他願意嫁給他。

chinese_meaning: 保持，維持，使持續，使繼續
example_en: The economy looks set to sustain its growth into next year.
example_zh: 看來經濟增長會持續到明年。

example_en: It was obvious she had broken her toe, because it immediately started to swell (up).
example_zh: 她的腳趾顯然已經骨折，因為立刻腫起來了。

example_en: The police took swift action against the rioters.
example_zh: 警方對暴動人員迅速採取了行動。

example_en: Which novels are on the syllabus this year?
example_zh: 今年的課程大綱裡列了哪些小說?

example_en: The skull at the bottom of the picture is symbolic of death.
example_zh: 圖片底部的骷髏象徵死亡。

example_en: I know what it's like to have migraines, so I really sympathize (with you).
example_zh: 我知道偏頭痛有多難受，所以我真的很同情你。

example_en: The words "small" and "little" are synonyms.
example_zh: small 和 little 是同義詞。

example_en: The words "annoyed" and "irritated" are more or less synonymous.
example_zh: annoyed 和 irritated 兩個詞幾乎是同義的。

chinese_meaning: 有條理的，有系統的，有計劃的
example_en: We've got to be more systematic in the way that we approach this task.
example_zh: 我們完成這項任務的時候應該更有條理一些。

chinese_meaning: 馬鞍;（腳踏車、機車等的）座墊，鞍座
example_en: My bike needs a new saddle.
example_zh: 我的自行車需要一個新鞍座。

chinese_meaning: （對行爲或性格的改善）有益的
example_en: a salutary experience
example_zh: 有益的經歷

chinese_meaning: 問候；（書信或演講開頭的）稱呼語

example_en: They are less sanguine about the prospects for peace.
example_zh: 他們對和平的前景不看好。

example_en: The grass had been saturated by overnight rain.
example_zh: 一夜的雨淋透了草地。

example_en: The critics scoffed at his paintings.
example_zh: 批評家對他的畫作嗤之以鼻。

example_en: His mother scolded him for breaking her favourite vase.
example_zh: 母親因爲他打碎了她最心愛的花瓶而責罵他。

chinese_meaning: 應時的；當令的；合時令的
example_en: December brought some seasonable snow showers.
example_zh: 12月下了幾場應時的陣雪。

chinese_meaning: （尤指基於種族或性別原因）隔離並差別對待
example_en: a segregated school/society
example_zh: 實行種族隔離的學校／社會

example_en: Basque separatism
example_zh: 巴斯克分裂主義

chinese_meaning: （玻璃杯、茶杯、容器或類似物品的）碎片
example_en: Shards of glass have been cemented into the top of the wall to stop people climbing over.
example_zh: 牆頭上用水泥黏著玻璃碎片，以防止人們翻牆過去。

chinese_meaning: 商店行竊;佯裝顧客偷竊
example_en: He was caught shoplifting by a store detective.
example_zh: 他因在商店順手牽羊被商店偵探抓獲。

example_en: She has to wear glasses because she's very short-sighted.
example_zh: 她必須戴眼鏡，因為她的近視很嚴重。

example_en: shrieks of delight
example_zh: 興奮的尖叫

example_en: He is a sluggard who loves sleep and hates work.
example_zh: 他是一個愛睡覺、討厭工作的懶漢。

example_en: They threatened to smother the animals with plastic bags.
example_zh: 他們威脅要用塑膠袋把這些動物悶死。

chinese_meaning: （尤指狗）齜牙低吼;（人）咆哮，吼叫
example_en: The dogs started to snarl at each other so I had to separate them.
example_zh: 兩條狗開始互相齜牙低吼，所以我不得不把牠們分開。

example_en: You may sneer, but a lot of people like this kind of music.
example_zh: 你可以嗤之以鼻，但很多人喜歡這種音樂。

chinese_meaning: 社會主義;社會主義制度
催眠的，使人昏昏欲睡的
example_en: the soporific effect of the heat
example_zh: 炎熱天氣的催眠作用

example_en: With a sorrowful sigh she folded the letter and put it away.
example_zh: 她悲傷地歎了口氣，把信折好收了起來。

example_en: Max was a spendthrift and a heavy gambler.
example_zh: 麥克斯是個揮霍無度的人，也是個重度賭徒。

chinese_meaning: 運動員;體育運動愛好者;（尤指）擅長體育運動者
example_en: He was voted Sportsperson of the Year.
example_zh: 他被選爲年度傑出運動員。

example_en: She sprained her ankle playing squash.
example_zh: 她打壁球扭傷了腳踝。

example_en: I knocked into her in the corridor and sent her sprawling (= knocked her over).
example_zh: 我在走廊裡和她迎頭相撞，把她撞了個四腳朝天。

chinese_meaning: 虛假的，欺騙的；（原因、判斷）謬誤的
example_en: Some of the arguments in favour of shutting the factory are questionable and others downright spurious.
example_zh: 贊成關閉工廠的那些論據，有些值得質疑，另一些則明顯站不住腳。

chinese_meaning: 嚴肅無趣的;一本正經的;古板的
example_en: In an attempt to change its staid image, the newspaper has created a new section aimed at younger readers.
example_zh: 那家報紙爲改變其古板的形象，開設了一個針對年輕讀者的新版面。

example_en: "Wh-when can we g-go?" she stammered.
example_zh: 「我們甚……甚麽時候能……能走？」她結結巴巴地說道。

chinese_meaning: 使大吃一驚；使受驚，使嚇一跳
example_en: She was concentrating on her book and his voice startled her.
example_zh: 她正在聚精會神地看書，被他的聲音嚇了一跳。

example_en: an influential and admired elder stateswoman
example_zh: 有影響力的、受人欽佩的年長女政治家

example_en: She agreed to buy the car, but stipulated racing tyres and a turbo-powered engine.
example_zh: 她同意買這輛車，但指明要裝賽車輪胎和渦輪動力引擎。

chinese_meaning: （人）不動感情的，淡漠的，無動於衷的;（事物）索然無趣的
example_en: He's a very stolid, serious man.
example_zh: 他是個喜怒不形於色、很嚴肅的人。

example_en: People are put off by his strident voice.
example_zh: 人們很厭惡他那刺耳的嗓音。

chinese_meaning: 使疲憊而思維不清，使因疲勞而昏昏沉沉

example_en: She stutters a little, so be patient and let her finish what she's saying.
example_zh: 她有點兒口吃，所以耐心些，讓她把話說完。

chinese_meaning: （使）潛入水中，（使）沒入水中；浸沒
example_en: The submarine submerged when enemy planes were sighted.
example_zh: 潛艇發現敵機後馬上下潛。

chinese_meaning: （使）潛入水中，（使）沒入水中;浸沒
example_en: The fruit was preserved by submersion in alcohol.
example_zh: 果實通過浸泡在酒精中來保存。

example_en: £50 would help to subsidize the training of an unemployed teenager.
example_zh: 50英鎊能夠資助一名無業青少年接受培訓。

example_en: The report said that the victims had suffocated in the fumes.
example_zh: 報告說那些受害者是被煙熏死的。

example_en: Printed books will soon be supplanted by e-books.
example_zh: 紙質書將很快被電子書取代。

chinese_meaning: 突然改變方向，緊急轉彎
example_en: The bus driver swerved to avoid hitting a cyclist.
example_zh: 為了不撞上騎自行車的人，這輛公共汽車只好緊急轉彎。

example_en: syntactic analysis
example_zh: 句法分析
